BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry Fitzgerald Paul Reynolds are offering for sale this bright and spacious semi detached property. 
Comprising well decorated accommodation including inviting entrance hallway, large living room, kitchen/dining area, utility and guest wc, with 4 double bedrooms on first floor, one of which is ensuite and family bathroom.
Set within the popular residential development of Harmony Hill and occupying a spacious site this property enjoys landscaped front lawns and rear garden with fence surround.
Ideal investment opportunity.
Convenient to Woodlands National School, Church and Town Centre.
Note: this property has not been tested for defective block, however, it forms part of a residential development where a number of properties have been tested and confirmed to have been constructed with defective block.

Entrance Hall - 5.5 x 2.5
Tiled flooring. Carpet covered staircase leading to first floor with under stair storage area. Coving and centre ceiling rose.

WC - 1.6 x 1.4
Tiled flooring. Comprising wc and wash hand basin.

Living Room - 4.8 x 4.0
Laminated timber flooring. Fireplace with solid fuel burning stove and back boiler to compliment the oil fired heating. Coving and center ceiling rose.

Kitchen/Dining Area - 6.6 x 4.5
Tiled flooring. Eye and low level units with tiled splash back and double drainer sink. Built in electric oven with four ring hob and overhead extractor fan. Integrated fridge freezer. Patio door leading to rear of property.

Utility Room - 2.1 x 1.3
Tiled flooring. Door to side of property.

Landing - 3.0 x 2.1
Carpet covering on floor. Trap door leading to attic.

Bedroom 1 - 3.9 x 2.6
Laminated timber flooring.

Ensuite - 2.7 x 1.1
Tiled flooring. Comprising w.c, wash hand basin and electric shower.

Bedroom 2 - 3.1 x 2.6
Laminated timber flooring.

Bedroom 3 - 3.8 x 2.6
Laminated timber flooring

Bedroom 4 - 4.0 x 2.7
Laminated timber flooring.

Bathroom - 3.0 x 1.8
Tiled flooring and walls tiled floor to ceiling. Comprising w.c, wash hand basin and bath.

• Semi detached house
  • Constructed 2004
  • Comprising 4 bedrooms, on of which is ensuite.
  • Total floor area 120 sq m (1300 sq ft)
  • Tastefully decorated internally
  • Solid fuel burning stove with back boiler to compliment the oil fired heating
  • All internal doors, architrave and skirting are pine
  • Occupying a spacious site
  • Lawn to front and garden area to rear
  • Timber shed to rear included in sale
  • Located within close proximity to town centre and all local amenities.
